payload.title: Singular Spectrum Analysis with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the application of Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA) using the Pyleoclim library, focusing on short and noisy time series data analysis.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and load the NINO3 dataset.
steps.title: Setup and Data Loading

steps.description: Standardize the NINO3 dataset and plot the standardized time series.
steps.title: Standardize and Plot Data

steps.description: Apply Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA) to the standardized dataset with a window length of 60.
steps.title: Perform SSA

steps.description: Generate a scree plot to visualize the variance explained by each SSA mode and calculate the cumulative variance for modes beyond the 15th.
steps.title: Scree Plot and Variance Calculation

steps.description: Apply Monte Carlo SSA with 1000 iterations and plot the scree plot.
steps.title: Monte-Carlo SSA

steps.description: Perform spectral analysis using MTM and WWZ methods and plot the results.
steps.title: SSA Pre-filtering

steps.description: Plot selected SSA modes to analyze their characteristics.
steps.title: Mode Plotting

steps.description: Introduce missing values into the dataset, perform SSA, and plot the results.
steps.title: SSA with Missing Values

steps.description: Use different truncation methods (Kaiser, MC SSA, Variance, Knee) for SSA approximation.
steps.title: SSA Approximation

steps.description: Apply the Kaiser method for SSA truncation and plot the reconstructed series.
steps.title: Kaiser Method

steps.description: Apply variance thresholding for SSA truncation and plot the reconstructed series.
steps.title: Variance Thresholding Method

steps.description: Apply the knee finding method for SSA truncation and plot the reconstructed series.
steps.title: Knee Finding Method

steps.description: Summarize the capabilities of SSA and its applications.
steps.title: Summary
